> 第13章 洛冰儿（第1页）
姬云生一听，心里喃喃道：“原来是这样啊，不过青玉宗是怎么回事？什么叫勉强算五品势力。”然后写道：“陈叔，为什么青玉宗勉强算五品势力呢？”陈明看完后，笑着回答道：“这个啊，青玉宗算五品势力的话，那也是青玉宗的宗主而言了。
根据外界传言，据说青玉宗宗主林玉子，自从皇朝一行回来后不久，突破修为虽然没有彻底突破元婴之上，但离那境界也只是差了半步。如果不算晓云的师尊，林玉子可是元阳王朝第一人了，所以在众人眼里，青玉宗的地位就更高了。”
姬云生一听，心里喃喃道：“也不知道这林玉子是谁？居然还能再如此贫瘠之地，突破半步化神，看来天赋确实不错。唉，等等，我想那么多干嘛！我这他喵的，连修为都没有，如何去评判其他人呢？万一被他听到了我心中所想，那岂不是找死了。”
然后写道：“陈叔，时间也不早了，你先回去休息吧！我在这里等姐姐回来就好，我也不知道为什么，自己会如此有精力。不睡觉居然都不困，真是奇怪了！”陈明看完后，笑着说道：“那好吧，不过要是太久你姐姐还没有回来，你也回去休息吧！
毕竟你如今也没有修为，要是不睡觉的话，可还是不好的。”姬云生一听点点头，陈明见状也回去房间休息了，毕竟他的身体不允许他不休息，而且当年之事，修为被废之后，他可是有伤在身。要是不好好休息的话，出现什么问题，陈晓云又要烦他了。
好几次就是因为他不好好休息，导致旧伤复发，每次都被陈晓云吵闹着好几天，他可不想再让女儿伤心难过了。姬云生见状也是找了个地方坐下，静静地看着天空的圆月发呆着，周围安静的都能清晰听到，夜晚虫鸣的声音。姬云生看着圆月发呆时，
心里喃喃道：“来到这世界都半年了，也不知道地球如此过去了多久，妈妈会不会担心我突然的失踪。尤其是兄弟们肯定了奇怪了，我记得那时候，我他喵的都要五杀了，要赢了啊。”想着想着，突然一声悦耳熟悉的声音传入耳中，姬云生也是回过神来，
拿出纸笔写道：“姐姐，你回来了啊？你事情都办完了？”陈晓云温柔笑着问道：“怎么？弟弟，才多久，弟弟是在想姐姐了吗？”姬云生一听写道：“怎么会呢？我只是在想一些事情而已，毕竟姐姐那么快就回来了，我情绪没有那么快就波动的。”
这时，另一道女声，好听的温柔说道：“晓月，你们姐弟还真是有意思啊。”姬云生一听顿时警觉起来，看着周围除了自己和陈晓云，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，这大晚上的不会见鬼了吧！”陈晓云见状没好气笑着说道：“师尊，你赶紧出来吧！都吓到我弟弟了！”
姬云生一听这才放心下来，心里喃喃道：“卧槽，吓我一跳，我还以为是谁呢？原来是晓月姐的师尊啊，我他喵的还以为出现幻听，遇到鬼了呢！”这时，一道身影缓缓从虚空之中显现出来，姬云生看着这突然出现的人，虽然又被吓一跳，但也没有太大感觉，
心里喃喃道：“我去，还真是个隐藏大佬了，就这手段而言，修为绝对不低，只是具体是多少就不知道了。”洛冰儿看着姬云生也是很好奇，好似对方不奇怪她的手段，顿时温柔问道：“小弟弟，你这好像并不奇怪我这样现身？你难道是大能转世？这也不对啊，
晓云可是说过了，你并不是这种情况。”姬云生一听，有些警惕，书写后展开道：“这位姐姐，你虽然是姐姐的师尊，但是多的恕我不便告知，还请见谅！我毕竟也是第一次见到你，而且你还是个蒙面之人，我也不了解你，所以还请不要私自打探我的秘密。
就算你修为是化神，或者之上，我也不会如此，就轻易相信你说的话。”洛冰儿一看，没好气说道：“你这小弟弟真有意思，你就不怕我直接搜魂吗？你毕竟一点修为都没有，还知道如此之多，居然还知道化神，我对于可是非常好奇的很呢！”

> Chapter 13 Luo Binger (Page 1)
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he murmured in his heart: "So that's it, but what happened to the Qingyu Sect? What does it mean to barely be considered a fifth-grade force?" Then he wrote: "Uncle Chen, why is the Qingyu Sect barely considered a fifth-grade force?" After reading it, Chen Ming replied with a smile: "Well, if the Qingyu Sect is a fifth-grade force, then it is the leader of the Qingyu Sect.
According to outside rumors, it is said that Lin Yuzi, the leader of the Qingyu Sect, has achieved a breakthrough in cultivation level shortly after the return of the Imperial Dynasty and his party. Although he has not completely broken through the Nascent Soul, he is only half a step away from that realm. If Xiaoyun's master is not included, Lin Yuzi is the number one person in the Yuanyang Dynasty, so in the eyes of everyone, the Qingyu Sect's status is even higher. "
When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he murmured in his heart: "I don't know who this Lin Yuzi is? He can actually break through half a step of becoming a god in such a barren land. It seems that his talent is really good. Oh, wait, why do I think so much! How can I judge other people when I don't even have any cultivation base? If he hears what I am thinking, wouldn't I be asking for death?"
Then he wrote: "Uncle Chen, it's getting late. You should go back and rest first! I just wait here for my sister to come back. I don't know why I am so energetic. It's strange that I don't feel sleepy even if I don't sleep!" After reading it, Chen Ming said with a smile: "Okay, but if your sister hasn't come back after too long, you should go back and rest too!
After all, you don't have any cultivation now, so it would still be bad if you don't sleep. "Ji Yunsheng nodded when he heard this. Chen Ming also went back to the room to rest after seeing this. After all, his body did not allow him not to rest, and he was injured after his cultivation was abolished that year. If something goes wrong if he doesn't get a good rest, Chen Xiaoyun will bother him again.
Several times, his old injuries recurred because he didn't take a good rest. Chen Xiaoyun would make noisy noises for several days each time. He didn't want to make his daughter sad anymore. When Ji Yunsheng saw this, he also found a place to sit down and stared at the full moon in the sky quietly in a daze. Even in the quiet surroundings, he could clearly hear the sound of insects chirping at night. When Ji Yunsheng looked at the full moon in a daze,
He murmured in his heart: "It's been half a year since I came to this world, and I don't know how long the earth has been like this. Will my mother be worried about my sudden disappearance? Especially the brothers must have thought it was strange. I remember that at that time, I had to kill five of them. I was going to win." After thinking about it, a pleasant and familiar voice suddenly came into his ears, and Ji Yunsheng came back to his senses.
He took out a pen and paper and wrote: "Sister, are you back? Have you finished everything?" Chen Xiaoyun asked with a gentle smile: "What? Brother, how long has it been? Is my brother thinking about my sister?" When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he wrote: "How could it be? I was just thinking about something. After all, my sister came back so soon, and my mood does not fluctuate so quickly."
At this time, another female voice said in a nice and gentle voice: "Xiaoyue, you siblings are really interesting." Ji Yunsheng immediately became alert when he heard this. He looked around except himself and Chen Xiaoyun, and murmured in his heart: "Damn it, you can't see ghosts this night!" Upon seeing this, Chen Xiaoyun said with an angry smile: "Master, come out quickly! You scared my brother!"
Ji Yunsheng felt relieved after hearing this, and murmured in his heart: "Damn, you scared me. Who did I think it was? It turned out to be Sister Xiaoyue's master. I thought I was hearing hallucinations and meeting a ghost!" At this time, a figure slowly appeared from the void. Ji Yunsheng looked at the sudden appearance of the person. Although he was startled again, he didn't feel much.
He murmured in his heart: "Here I go, he is really a hidden boss. As far as this method is concerned,The cultivation base is definitely not low, but I don’t know exactly how much. Luo Bing'er looked at Ji Yunsheng very curiously, as if the other party was not surprised by her methods, and immediately asked gently: "Little brother, you don't seem to be surprised that I show up like this?" Are you the reincarnation of a powerful person? This isn't right either,
Xiaoyun has said that this is not the case for you. When Ji Yunsheng heard this, he was a little wary. After writing, he unfolded it and said: "Sister, although you are my sister's master, please forgive me for the inconvenience of telling you more!" After all, this is my first time meeting you, and you are still a masked person. I don’t know you, so please don’t pry into my secrets privately.
Even if your cultivation is at the level of God Transformation or above, I will not believe what you say so easily. Luo Bing'er looked at it and said angrily: "You little brother is really interesting. Aren't you afraid that I will search for your soul directly?" After all, you have no cultivation at all, yet you know so much, and you actually know how to transform into gods. I am very curious about this! "
